deliverables: cloud Org Policy, home-project IAM, and capacity-tier readiness proof
generation-compatible thinking_level and sampling adapter configuration
root, intro, and grounded sub-agent reasoning-level parity across dev, uat, and production
current generated product-agent registry and live A/B latency + inference verification
impact_fields: Supported model IDs and provider bindings
Root and sub-agent thinking_level / latency budgets
Cloud Org Policy, IAM, and quota/GSU posture
Generated agent registry and readiness probes
common_failures: probing or deploying a new Vertex model before vertexai.allowedModels Org Policy allowlist propagates across org and home projects

pinning thinking_level only on the root chat head or UAT ManagedPrimaryTextModel while leaving native Vertex child AgentTools (such as google_search) at unbounded dynamic HIGH thinking (25-29s latency)
passing unsupported MINIMAL thinking_level, deprecated thinking_budget, or silent no-op temperature/top_p fields to a new thinking-first model release
updating default model constants without updating model_catalog, manifests, or regenerated product-agent-registry.v2.json so live chat self-reports the retired model
purchasing regional Provisioned Throughput when the runtime calls the global endpoint, or forgetting to re-enable BigQuery Billing Export after a billing-account migration
